body.target_rule: The target permit.decision.v1 claim MUST be supported before co-signature adjudication. permit_id and permit_decision_canonical_hash MUST equal the supported decision evidence.
body.pack_rule: The signed pack MUST integrity-protect the complete v2 claim, target Permit-decision evidence, and signed co-signer key manifest.

verdicts.supported: target decision, pack, key, ceremony, and assertion signature all verify
verdicts.disproved: present target binding, ceremony, credential, or signature evidence conflicts
verdicts.insufficient_evidence: target decision, pack, trusted key, or required ceremony evidence is absent
verdicts.unverifiable_scope: claim version, target binding version, or COSE algorithm is unsupported
